report.title: Changed samples since import
report.description: Lists changed samples still linked to an insert-only import.
report.query: SELECT #columns# FROM imports i JOIN samples s ON s.import_guid = i.import_guid WHERE i.import_guid = '#import_guid#' AND i.updated = 0 AND s.deleted = false AND ( s.updated_on != s.created_on OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM occurrences o WHERE o.sample_id = s.id AND o.deleted = false AND (o.updated_on != o.created_on OR o.import_guid IS DISTINCT FROM i.import_guid) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM samples child WHERE child.parent_id = s.id AND child.deleted = false ) )
